description: Source file implementing utility functions for handling named tensor dimensions, including conversion between names and positions, name propagation, and name-based tensor operations within the ATen library of PyTorch.

classes.name: TensorName
classes.description: Represents a dimension name of a tensor, supporting name unification, wildcard, and basic name distinction.

classes.name: TensorNames
classes.description: Handles a list of tensor dimension names, supporting operations such as unification from the right and appending names.

methods.name: std::string toDimnameRepr(const Tensor & tensor)
methods.description: Returns a string representation of a tensor with its dimension names, e.g., "Tensor['N', 'C', 'H', 'W']".

methods.name: int64_t dimname_to_position(const Tensor & tensor,Dimname dim)
methods.description: Finds the position index of a dimension name within a tensor based on its name.

methods.description: Converts a list of dimension names to their respective positions within a tensor.

methods.description: Reports an error when attempting to align or compare dimension names that do not match.
